name: enable_indexonlyscan
description: Enables or disables the query planner's use of index-only scan plan types, which retrieve data solely from indexes without accessing heap pages.
symptoms: Unnecessarily slow queries on covered index scans
Increased I/O due to redundant heap fetches
Higher CPU usage from unnecessary tuple visibility checks
tuning_tips: Leave enabled unless diagnosing specific planner regressions; disable only temporarily for comparison during query plan analysis.
